# Whiteheap

> Open-source tools and infrastructure for agents, developers and security teams, all written in Rust.

Each tool is one binary with no runtime to install. Every release carries SHA-256 checksums and a GitHub build-provenance attestation (`gh attestation verify <file> --repo whiteheap/<tool>`).

## Tools

- [residue](https://github.com/whiteheap/residue): finds the Git worktrees coding agents leave behind, and removes one only when nothing in it would be lost. One Rust binary with one dependency (`libc`), for macOS and Linux. Install: `brew install whiteheap/tap/residue`
